'''Volume 1''' is the first volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version.

==Blurb==
''Casey and Henry can’t enter Galar region tournaments without the support of the local champion, Leon! But with train disruptions, Team Yell and wild Dynamax Pokémon getting in their way, will they ever get a chance to impress him?!''

''Who’s going to get these wandering Wooloo off the train tracks?''
